page.overview:
Who is Alma?

is a halfling midwife and member of the Air Ashari in Zephrah. As an NPC, Alma is played by Matthew Mercer.

Alma is a halfling woman in her sixties, with slightly hunched shoulders and strong legs. She has long reddish brown curly hair with streaks of white, and pale blue eyes. She and Orym look alike, especially when they smile. When Bells Hells encountered her, she was barefoot and wearing a flowing white and green dress.

Alma is a sweet and good-natured woman, and a very proud mother.

At some point in her life Alma became one of the few midwives of Zephrah, a position that made her very valued in her community. Between 806 and 807 PD she was involved with another halfling, surnamed Tarrintel, and she became pregnant, but by the time she gave birth the man had left town and had no contact with his son.
